overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains an active, specialized professional presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His content focuses heavily on computational social science, coordinated inauthentic behavior, tool releases (CooRnet), and academic recruitment, driving strong engagement among researchers and industry peers.

contentThemes.description: Announcements regarding research grants, published papers on disinformation, and conference presentations.
Updates on software releases like CooRnet v2.0 and discussions around methodological approaches.
Recruitment posts for postdoctoral researchers and research opportunities for PhD students.

recommendations: Cross-promote open software releases and academic papers on LinkedIn to capitalize on its high absolute reach.
Include direct links and visuals (charts, paper preview cards) to boost post click-through rates and sharing dynamics on Mastodon and Bluesky.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates the highest relative engagement rate (6.14% average) driven by high repost counts on research opportunities and new paper publications.
platformInsights.mastodon: Yields solid engagement around technical and methodological updates like tool releases (CooRnet), indicating a niche academic/technical audience.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest overall volume of likes and comments (especially for grant awards and hiring posts), making it ideal for professional networking and institutional updates.
